extracted.intended_audience: investor relations professionals, corporate communications officers, and people researching the National Investor Relations Institute
extracted.subtask_description: A short encyclopedia entry describing the National Investor Relations Institute (NIRI), its mission, membership, and the standards/guidance it publishes for investor relations and corporate disclosure practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publishes 'best practices' guidelines for public companies
rubrics_metrics.description: It publishes "best practices" guidelines for public companies which encourage companies to adopt a written disclosure policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page states NIRI issues best-practices guidance that specifically encourages adoption of a written disclosure policy; no further specifics, scoring, examples, or the text of those guidelines are provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investor Relations Charter (professional credential)
rubrics_metrics.description: In 2016, NIRI introduced the first Investor Relations professional credential in the U.S., the Investor Relations Charter(sm).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page identifies the existence of a professional credential as a standard/credentialing mechanism for IR professionals but does not provide the requirements, curriculum, or evaluation criteria for obtaining the Charter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advance engagement and drive best practices in corporate disclosures, governance, and informed investing
rubrics_metrics.description: Through its collaborative community, NIRI advances engagement in the capital markets and drives best practices in corporate disclosures, governance, and informed investing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This describes NIRI's mission to promote high standards in disclosure, governance, and investor information; the page gives no itemized criteria or procedural standards for what those best practices entail.
